# stripe_payment_link (Data Source)

A shareable link to a Stripe-hosted page that takes a payment. `terraform destroy` deactivates the link (`active = false`), because Stripe cannot delete one: the link stays in the account and stops taking payments. `active` is an ordinary argument, so a link can be deactivated and activated again. `line_items` are matched by `price`, never by position: a reorder changes nothing, and a changed `quantity` updates the item in place. Adding a price, dropping one or changing an item's other settings replaces the link, and so does a change to any argument other than `active`, `allow_promotion_codes`, `billing_address_collection`, `submit_type`, `metadata` and the quantity of a line item. A replaced link has a new `url`. A price may appear once. A line item names its `price`: `price_data`, which would create the price with the link, is not available, because an item without a price of its own cannot be told from another when Stripe returns them, so create the price with `stripe_price` first. A link takes at most 20 line items, and the provider reads at most the first 10 of them: a link with more is an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_payment_link" "course" {
  id = stripe_payment_link.course.id
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the object.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the payment link's `url` is active. If `false`, customers visiting the URL will be shown a page saying that the link has been deactivated.
- `after_completion` (Attributes) Behavior after the purchase is complete. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--after_completion))
- `allow_promotion_codes` (Boolean) Enables user redeemable promotion codes.
- `application` (String) The ID of the Connect application that created the Payment Link.
- `application_fee_amount` (Number) The amount of the application fee (if any) that will be requested to be applied to the payment and transferred to the application owner's Stripe account. Can only be applied when there are no line items with recurring prices.
- `application_fee_percent` (Number) A non-negative decimal between 0 and 100, with at most two decimal places. This represents the percentage of the subscription invoice total that will be transferred to the application owner's Stripe account. There must be at least 1 line item with a recurring price to use this field.
- `automatic_tax` (Attributes) Configuration for automatic tax collection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--automatic_tax))
- `billing_address_collection` (String) Configuration for collecting the customer's billing address. Defaults to `auto`. Possible values: `auto`, `required`.
- `consent_collection` (Attributes) Configure fields to gather active consent from customers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--consent_collection))
- `currency` (String) Three-letter [ISO currency code](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html), in lowercase. Must be a [supported currency](https://stripe.com/docs/currencies) and supported by each line item's price.
- `custom_fields` (Attributes List) Collect additional information from your customer using custom fields. Up to 3 fields are supported. You can't set this parameter if `ui_mode` is `elements`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_fields))
- `custom_text` (Attributes) Display additional text for your customers using custom text. You can't set this parameter if `ui_mode` is `elements`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_text))
- `customer_creation` (String) Configures whether [checkout sessions](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions) created by this payment link create a [Customer](https://docs.stripe.com/api/customers). Possible values: `always`, `if_required`.
- `inactive_message` (String) The custom message to be displayed to a customer when a payment link is no longer active.
- `invoice_creation` (Attributes) Generate a post-purchase Invoice for one-time payments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--invoice_creation))
- `line_items` (Attributes List) The line items representing what is being sold. Each line item represents an item being sold. Up to 20 line items are supported. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items))
- `livemode` (Boolean) If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
- `managed_payments` (Attributes) Settings for Managed Payments for this Payment Link and resulting [CheckoutSessions](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions/object), [PaymentIntents](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents/object), [Invoices](https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices/object), and [Subscriptions](https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions/object). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--managed_payments))
- `metadata` (Map of String) Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`. Metadata associated with this Payment Link will automatically be copied to [checkout sessions](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions) created by this payment link.
- `name_collection` (Attributes) Controls settings applied for collecting the customer's name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name_collection))
- `on_behalf_of` (String) The account on behalf of which to charge.
- `optional_items` (Attributes List) A list of optional items the customer can add to their order at checkout. Use this parameter to pass one-time or recurring [Prices](https://docs.stripe.com/api/prices).
There is a maximum of 10 optional items allowed on a payment link, and the existing limits on the number of line items allowed on a payment link apply to the combined number of line items and optional items.
There is a maximum of 20 combined line items and optional items. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--optional_items))
- `payment_intent_data` (Attributes) A subset of parameters to be passed to PaymentIntent creation for Checkout Sessions in `payment` mode. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--payment_intent_data))
- `payment_method_collection` (String) Specify whether Checkout should collect a payment method. When set to `if_required`, Checkout will not collect a payment method when the total due for the session is 0.This may occur if the Checkout Session includes a free trial or a discount. Can only be set in `subscription` mode. Defaults to `always`. If you'd like information on how to collect a payment method outside of Checkout, read the guide on [configuring subscriptions with a free trial](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/free-trials). Possible values: `always`, `if_required`.
- `payment_method_options` (Attributes) Payment-method-specific configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--payment_method_options))
- `payment_method_types` (List of String) The list of payment method types that customers can use. If no value is passed, Stripe will dynamically show relevant payment methods from your [payment method settings](https://dashboard.stripe.com/settings/payment_methods) (20+ payment methods [supported](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/payment-methods/integration-options#payment-method-product-support)).
- `phone_number_collection` (Attributes) Controls phone number collection settings during checkout. We recommend that you review your privacy policy and check with your legal contacts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_number_collection))
- `restrictions` (Attributes) Settings that restrict the usage of a payment link. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--restrictions))
- `shipping_address_collection` (Attributes) Configuration for collecting the customer's shipping address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shipping_address_collection))
- `shipping_options` (Attributes List) The shipping rate options to apply to [checkout sessions](https://docs.stripe.com/api/checkout/sessions) created by this payment link. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shipping_options))
- `submit_type` (String) Describes the type of transaction being performed in order to customize relevant text on the page, such as the submit button. Changing this value will also affect the hostname in the [url](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_links/payment_links/object#url) property (example: `donate.stripe.com`). Possible values: `auto`, `book`, `donate`, `pay`, `subscribe`.
- `subscription_data` (Attributes) When creating a subscription, the specified configuration data will be used. There must be at least one line item with a recurring price to use `subscription_data`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscription_data))
- `tax_id_collection` (Attributes) Controls tax ID collection during checkout. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tax_id_collection))
- `transfer_data` (Attributes) The account (if any) the payments will be attributed to for tax reporting, and where funds from each payment will be transferred to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--transfer_data))
- `url` (String) The public URL that can be shared with customers.

<a id="nestedatt--line_items--discounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.discounts`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) The amount discounted.
- `discount` (Attributes) A discount represents the actual application of a [coupon](https://docs.stripe.com/api#coupons) or [promotion code](https://docs.stripe.com/api#promotion_codes).
It contains information about when the discount began, when it will end, and what it is applied to. Related guide: [Applying discounts to subscriptions](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/discounts) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items--discounts--discount))

<a id="nestedatt--line_items--discounts--discount"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.discounts.discount`

Read-Only:

- `checkout_session` (String) The Checkout session that this coupon is applied to, if it is applied to a particular session in payment mode. Not present for subscription mode.
- `customer` (String) The ID of the customer associated with this discount.
- `customer_account` (String) The ID of the account representing the customer associated with this discount.
- `end` (Number) If the coupon has a duration of `repeating`, the date that this discount will end. If the coupon has a duration of `once` or `forever`, this attribute will be null.
- `id` (String) The ID of the discount object. Discounts can't be fetched by ID. Use `expand[]=discounts` in API calls to expand discount IDs in an array.
- `invoice` (String) The invoice that the discount's coupon was applied to, if it was applied directly to a particular invoice.
- `invoice_item` (String) The invoice item `id` (or invoice line item `id` for invoice line items of type='subscription') that the discount's coupon was applied to, if it was applied directly to a particular invoice item or invoice line item.
- `object` (String) String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value. Possible values: `discount`.
- `promotion_code` (String) The promotion code applied to create this discount.
- `source` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items--discounts--discount--source))
- `start` (Number) Date that the coupon was applied.
- `subscription` (String) The subscription that this coupon is applied to, if it is applied to a particular subscription.
- `subscription_item` (String) The subscription item that this coupon is applied to, if it is applied to a particular subscription item.

<a id="nestedatt--line_items--discounts--discount--source"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.discounts.discount.source`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) The source type of the discount. Possible values: `coupon`.




<a id="nestedatt--line_items--taxes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.taxes`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) Amount of tax applied for this rate.
- `rate` (Attributes) Tax rates can be applied to [invoices](https://docs.stripe.com/invoicing/taxes/tax-rates), [subscriptions](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/taxes/tax-rates) and [Checkout Sessions](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout/use-manual-tax-rates) to collect tax. Related guide: [Tax rates](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/taxes/tax-rates) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items--taxes--rate))
- `taxability_reason` (String) The reasoning behind this tax, for example, if the product is tax exempt. The possible values for this field may be extended as new tax rules are supported. Possible values: `customer_exempt`, `not_collecting`, `not_subject_to_tax`, `not_supported`, `portion_product_exempt`, `portion_reduced_rated`, `portion_standard_rated`, `product_exempt`, `product_exempt_holiday`, `proportionally_rated`, `reduced_rated`, `reverse_charge`, `standard_rated`, `taxable_basis_reduced`, `zero_rated`.
- `taxable_amount` (Number) The amount on which tax is calculated, in cents (or local equivalent).

<a id="nestedatt--line_items--taxes--rate"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.taxes.rate`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Defaults to `true`. When set to `false`, this tax rate cannot be used with new applications or Checkout Sessions, but will still work for subscriptions and invoices that already have it set.
- `country` (String) Two-letter country code ([ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2)).
- `created` (Number) Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
- `description` (String) An arbitrary string attached to the tax rate for your internal use only. It will not be visible to your customers.
- `display_name` (String) The display name of the tax rates as it will appear to your customer on their receipt email, PDF, and the hosted invoice page.
- `effective_percentage` (Number) Actual/effective tax rate percentage out of 100. For tax calculations with automatic_tax[enabled]=true,
this percentage reflects the rate actually used to calculate tax based on the product's taxability
and whether the user is registered to collect taxes in the corresponding jurisdiction.
- `flat_amount` (Attributes) The amount of the tax rate when the `rate_type` is `flat_amount`. Tax rates with `rate_type` `percentage` can vary based on the transaction, resulting in this field being `null`. This field exposes the amount and currency of the flat tax rate. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--line_items--taxes--rate--flat_amount))
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the object.
- `inclusive` (Boolean) This specifies if the tax rate is inclusive or exclusive.
- `jurisdiction` (String) The jurisdiction for the tax rate. You can use this label field for tax reporting purposes. It also appears on your customer’s invoice.
- `jurisdiction_level` (String) The level of the jurisdiction that imposes this tax rate. Will be `null` for manually defined tax rates. Possible values: `city`, `country`, `county`, `district`, `multiple`, `state`.
- `livemode` (Boolean) If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.
- `object` (String) String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value. Possible values: `tax_rate`.
- `percentage` (Number) Tax rate percentage out of 100. For tax calculations with automatic_tax[enabled]=true, this percentage includes the statutory tax rate of non-taxable jurisdictions.
- `rate_type` (String) Indicates the type of tax rate applied to the taxable amount. This value can be `null` when no tax applies to the location. This field is only present for TaxRates created by Stripe Tax. Possible values: `flat_amount`, `percentage`.
- `state` (String) [ISO 3166-2 subdivision code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-2), without country prefix. For example, "NY" for New York, United States.
- `tax_type` (String) The high-level tax type, such as `vat` or `sales_tax`. Possible values: `amusement_tax`, `communications_tax`, `digital_excise_tax`, `gst`, `hst`, `igst`, `jct`, `lease_tax`, `mass_transit_parking_tax`, `parking_tax`, `pst`, `qst`, `retail_delivery_fee`, `rst`, `sales_tax`, `service_tax`, `utility_users_tax`, `vat`.

<a id="nestedatt--line_items--taxes--rate--flat_amount"></a>
### Nested Schema for `line_items.taxes.rate.flat_amount`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) Amount of the tax when the `rate_type` is `flat_amount`. This positive integer represents how much to charge in the smallest currency unit (e.g., 100 cents to charge $1.00 or 100 to charge ¥100, a zero-decimal currency). The amount value supports up to eight digits (e.g., a value of 99999999 for a USD charge of $999,999.99).
- `currency` (String) Three-letter ISO currency code, in lowercase.





<a id="nestedatt--managed_payments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `managed_payments`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Set to `true` to enable [Managed Payments](https://docs.stripe.com/payments/managed-payments), Stripe's merchant of record solution, for this session.


<a id="nestedatt--name_collection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `name_collection`

Read-Only:

- `business` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name_collection--business))
- `individual` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name_collection--individual))

<a id="nestedatt--name_collection--business"></a>
### Nested Schema for `name_collection.business`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether business name collection is enabled for the payment link.
- `optional` (Boolean) Whether the customer is required to complete the field before checking out. Defaults to `false`.


<a id="nestedatt--name_collection--individual"></a>
### Nested Schema for `name_collection.individual`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether individual name collection is enabled for the payment link.
- `optional` (Boolean) Whether the customer is required to complete the field before checking out. Defaults to `false`.



<a id="nestedatt--optional_items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `optional_items`

Read-Only:

- `adjustable_quantity` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--optional_items--adjustable_quantity))
- `price` (String)
- `quantity` (Number)

<a id="nestedatt--optional_items--adjustable_quantity"></a>
### Nested Schema for `optional_items.adjustable_quantity`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Set to true if the quantity can be adjusted to any non-negative integer.
- `maximum` (Number) The maximum quantity of this item the customer can purchase. By default this value is 99.
- `minimum` (Number) The minimum quantity of this item the customer must purchase, if they choose to purchase it. Because this item is optional, the customer will always be able to remove it from their order, even if the `minimum` configured here is greater than 0. By default this value is 0.



<a id="nestedatt--payment_intent_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_intent_data`

Read-Only:

- `capture_method` (String) Indicates when the funds will be captured from the customer's account. Possible values: `automatic`, `automatic_async`, `manual`.
- `description` (String) An arbitrary string attached to the object. Often useful for displaying to users.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that will set metadata on [Payment Intents](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents) generated from this payment link.
- `setup_future_usage` (String) Indicates that you intend to make future payments with the payment method collected during checkout. Possible values: `off_session`, `on_session`.
- `statement_descriptor` (String) For a non-card payment, information about the charge that appears on the customer's statement when this payment succeeds in creating a charge.
- `statement_descriptor_suffix` (String) For a card payment, information about the charge that appears on the customer's statement when this payment succeeds in creating a charge. Concatenated with the account's statement descriptor prefix to form the complete statement descriptor.
- `transfer_group` (String) A string that identifies the resulting payment as part of a group. See the PaymentIntents [use case for connected accounts](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/separate-charges-and-transfers) for details.


<a id="nestedatt--payment_method_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_method_options`

Read-Only:

- `card` (Attributes) Configuration for `card` payment methods. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--payment_method_options--card))

<a id="nestedatt--payment_method_options--card"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_method_options.card`

Read-Only:

- `restrictions` (Attributes) Restrictions to apply to the card payment method. For example, you can block specific card brands. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--payment_method_options--card--restrictions))

<a id="nestedatt--payment_method_options--card--restrictions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_method_options.card.restrictions`

Read-Only:

- `brands_blocked` (List of String) The card brands to block. If a customer enters or selects a card belonging to a blocked brand, they can't complete the payment.




<a id="nestedatt--phone_number_collection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phone_number_collection`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) If `true`, a phone number will be collected during checkout.


<a id="nestedatt--restrictions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `restrictions`

Read-Only:

- `completed_sessions` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--restrictions--completed_sessions))

<a id="nestedatt--restrictions--completed_sessions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `restrictions.completed_sessions`

Read-Only:

- `count` (Number) The current number of checkout sessions that have been completed on the payment link which count towards the `completed_sessions` restriction to be met.
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of checkout sessions that can be completed for the `completed_sessions` restriction to be met.



<a id="nestedatt--shipping_address_collection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shipping_address_collection`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_countries` (List of String) An array of two-letter ISO country codes representing which countries Checkout should provide as options for shipping locations. Unsupported country codes: `AS, CX, CC, CU, HM, IR, KP, MH, FM, NF, MP, PW, SD, SY, UM, VI`.


<a id="nestedatt--shipping_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shipping_options`

Read-Only:

- `shipping_amount` (Number) A non-negative integer in cents representing how much to charge.
- `shipping_rate` (String) The ID of the Shipping Rate to use for this shipping option.


<a id="nestedatt--subscription_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscription_data`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) The subscription's description, meant to be displayable to the customer. Use this field to optionally store an explanation of the subscription for rendering in Stripe surfaces and certain local payment methods UIs.
- `invoice_settings` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscription_data--invoice_settings))
- `metadata` (Map of String) Set of [key-value pairs](https://docs.stripe.com/api/metadata) that will set metadata on [Subscriptions](https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions) generated from this payment link.
- `trial_period_days` (Number) Integer representing the number of trial period days before the customer is charged for the first time.
- `trial_settings` (Attributes) Settings related to subscription trials. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscription_data--trial_settings))

<a id="nestedatt--subscription_data--invoice_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscription_data.invoice_settings`

Read-Only:

- `issuer` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscription_data--invoice_settings--issuer))

<a id="nestedatt--subscription_data--invoice_settings--issuer"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscription_data.invoice_settings.issuer`

Read-Only:

- `account` (String) The connected account being referenced when `type` is `account`.
- `type` (String) Type of the account referenced. Possible values: `account`, `self`.



<a id="nestedatt--subscription_data--trial_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscription_data.trial_settings`

Read-Only:

- `end_behavior` (Attributes) Defines how a subscription behaves when a free trial ends. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscription_data--trial_settings--end_behavior))

<a id="nestedatt--subscription_data--trial_settings--end_behavior"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscription_data.trial_settings.end_behavior`

Read-Only:

- `missing_payment_method` (String) Indicates how the subscription should change when the trial ends if the user did not provide a payment method. Possible values: `cancel`, `create_invoice`, `pause`.




<a id="nestedatt--tax_id_collection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tax_id_collection`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether tax ID collection is enabled for the session.
- `required` (String) Possible values: `if_supported`, `never`.


<a id="nestedatt--transfer_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `transfer_data`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (Number) The amount in cents (or local equivalent) that will be transferred to the destination account. By default, the entire amount is transferred to the destination.
- `destination` (String) The connected account receiving the transfer.
